why_this_task_exists: Provides a bounded protocol anchor where interface differences should be smaller than on safety-critical execution tasks.
Provides a reasoning and parameter-selection anchor where embodiment should matter less than basic protocol following.
Measures whether sterile, local, multi-step wet-lab execution benefits from grounded action selection and PPE discipline.
Measures whether local grounded control helps with explicit PPE, hazard handling, and ordered safety recovery.
Measures whether stateful recovery and safe intervention outperform purely global situational planning.
Acts as a boundary-case search task where broad global inspection may be as useful as or better than local grounded control.
Bridges global search and grounded disposal by combining identification work with one embodied corrective action.
Measures whether local grounded execution helps maintain chain-of-custody state across rooms and storage locations.
Measures whether agents can preserve local state, wait correctly, and finish a timed protocol without interrupting equipment early.
Measures whether grounded coordination and waiting behavior help under shared-resource contention and timed completion.
Tests whether the benchmark distinguishes a grounded feasible triage branch from a superficially plausible but unhelpful repeated PCR branch.
Tests grounded sterile containment with explicit quarantine, preserved-control, and no-open-handling criteria.
Tests whether grounded action loops can preserve a temperature-sensitive sample across room transitions and timed equipment execution.
Tests prioritized safety recovery when two hazards compete and the correct order is part of the scientific claim.
